appearancePlaceholder: e.g. curly brown hair, green eyes, freckles, loves a yellow raincoat
photoHint: Upload a clear photo of your child's face and we'll draw the character to look like them.
photoConsent: I confirm I am the child's parent or legal guardian and agree that this photo is used to create the book's illustrations.
photoConsentRequired: To upload a photo, first tick the consent box above.
photoPrivacy: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8MB. The photo is stored privately and location data is removed. To draw the character it is sent to an AI image service (Azure OpenAI) and used for nothing else. It is deleted automatically as soon as you approve the character, and you can remove it at any time before that.

photoTooLarge: The photo must be at most {{mb}}MB.
photoRegenerateHint: Changed the photo? Press "Regenerate" to redraw the character.
extraCharactersPlaceholder: e.g. little brother Luka, grandma Eteri, a dog named Bobi
previewIntro: Here is your book before you pay: the cover, your character and the full story, page by page. Check that everything looks right.
previewPhotoUsed: Your photo was used to draw the character, and every page will match the approved character.
previewIncludesPages: {{count}} fully illustrated pages with the story above
previewIncludesPdf: A downloadable PDF of the book
previewIncludesRevision: One free revision of any page
previewConfirmHint: Illustrations are painted after payment, using the character you approved.
storyTextMissing: This book still has placeholder text on its pages. Press the button and the AI will write the real story for the existing pictures.
siblingsHint: Add up to {{max}} siblings. They will star in the same story and appear on the pictures together with the main character.
siblingPhotoHint: A clear photo of this child's face, so we can draw them to look like them.
storyReviewIntro: The pictures are drawn from this text, so please read every page first. You can change any word, and nothing is drawn until you approve.

storyApproveButton: Approve text and create the character

printSettingsIntro: Download a print-ready PDF at the paper size you need. Pictures and text are laid out again for the chosen size.
printBleedHint: For a print shop: adds an extra edge that is cut off after printing. For home printing choose None.
fontHint: Choose the lettering for the story in the book and the PDF. You can change it any time, free of charge.

styleClassicHint: The look of a classic storybook
